domains.summary: Policy is tightening: the FOMC raised the target range 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16 (first hike since 2023) and 16 of 18 participants projected at least one more hike this year. Long yields spiked on Oct 5 (10Y about 5.34%, 30Y about 5.70%, highest since 2002) and eased slightly on Oct 6 (10Y about 5.27%). We read the liquidity backdrop as tightening. No September CPI print or current oil/dollar levels could be verified this run. Update: a prediction-market snapshot from Oct 2 put the odds of an October hike near 26% while another source says roughly even, so we treat hike odds as unresolved; September CPI is scheduled for Oct 14 (August headline was 3.4% YoY). Brent was reported above $100 in early October and slipped below on Oct 6 (low-confidence, secondary sources). hl-cycles Macro lens is 32 (Restrictive), -21 points over 30 days. Update 2026-10-10: web search found no fresh yield/CPI data; figures remain as of Oct 5-6 (stale).

US cash market status at write time unknown; levels are as of the Oct 5-6 sessions. thesis.observe: The Fed hiked to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16; the 10Y was about 5.3% around Oct 5-6 (stale; no newer print found). On Hyperliquid, BTC is $82,733, ETH $2,495, SOL $109.83; perp OI is about $11.9B (z30 -1.2), BTC funding z30 -1.4, with no series at |z30|≥2. Fear & Greed is 64. hl-cycles moved to mild risk-on for BTC (1 of 6 stress conditions: ETF 7d outflow -5,470), Compass 48 (Neutral), Macro lens 31 (Restrictive). September CPI is due Oct 14; Russia/Iran sanctions deadline is Oct 18.
thesis.infer: Positioning is subdued but no longer deteriorating on the app's baselines. We read the hl-cycles downgrade as a modest weakening (ETF outflows, momentum +29 vs +53 a week ago) rather than a break; with long yields elevated and the Macro lens Restrictive the backdrop is not supportive. Consensus is pricing an uncertain October FOMC; we read September CPI as the swing input. Low-confidence.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): range-bound crypto with subdued leverage while long yields stay elevated. Tail case (low-confidence): a hot CPI or further long-end spike forces a repricing, and risk skews toward a sharper leg down in high-beta alts; hl-cycles would flag a daily close below $81.6K (ETF cost basis) as invalidating its risk-on read, a daily close above $105.5K with realized cap growing would confirm it. Second tail case (low-confidence): the Oct 18 sanctions deadline broadens into a trade shock. Consensus is pricing a split October decision; we read the risk as hinging on September CPI.
thesis.disclaimer: Not financial advice. Market intelligence only — a reasoned read of public data, not a recommendation to buy or sell anything.
